result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to make people more capable of understanding each other across differences—cultures, beliefs, experiences, and fears.

Not necessarily agreeing with everyone, but having the patience, humility, and curiosity to see why others think and feel the way they do. That would likely reduce cruelty, improve conflict resolution, and make cooperation easier in places where it matters most: families, communities, workplaces, and nations.
